## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Quarteira, Portugal. It starts at Aquashow Park, Volta do Parque n.º 1, 8125-313 Quarteira, Portugal.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Visit the Aquashow Indoor, the first covered waterpark in the Iberian Peninsula. Enjoy a space with heated air and water, making summer a reality all year round. In this new space, find family pools, Jacuzzis, water slides, a baby pool, water jets, waterfalls, an adventure pool with a climbing wall and hammock, a wave pool, and a children's pool with slides and water cannons.
>
> There is also an exclusive spa area for guests over 13 years old. Relax in a pool with Jacuzzis, water beds with bubbles, a fast-flowing river circuit, a sensory tour, a bucket shower, a Scottish shower, a shower with essential oils, an essence pool, a sauna, a Turkish bath, a spa, an ice-cold well, an ice fountain, and two massage rooms.
>
> Take a break from your routine and enjoy a unique experience.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €34.45. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 210 ratings and 78 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from
